decisions.reason: SHAP causal-warning source and Phase 41 runtime contract now directly support attribution as audit/debug hint only, not causal evidence or final-gate authority.
content_patch_notes: Formal reviewed draft must keep causal_claim_allowed=false and final_gate_decision_allowed=false.
Attribution usage must be limited to debugging, audit_hint, and reviewer_context.
boundary_patch_notes: Do not use attribution as causal evidence, trading rule evidence, final gate decision, or allow/block/reduce_size signal.

decisions.reason: Active learning, OHEM concept source, and Phase 41 training-data contract now support sampling enhancement with gold/eval isolation and sampling-bias controls.
content_patch_notes: Formal reviewed draft must require active_learning_sample, random_control_sample, stratified_sample, sampling_bias_review, and no_gold_eval_contamination.
Hard-example mining must be scoped to review sampling enhancement only.
boundary_patch_notes: No performance claim is allowed from hard-example mining alone.
Gold/eval contamination must block training or require resplitting.

decisions.reason: Model optimization and RAG evaluation sources now support establishing RAG, prompt, and eval baselines before SFT/LoRA.
content_patch_notes: Formal reviewed draft must require rag_baseline_report, prompt_baseline_report, eval_set_hash, schema_valid_rate, citation_resolved_rate, reason_code_consistency, and unsupported_claim_rate before SFT/LoRA.
SFT/LoRA can only train format, reason code, citation habit, and audit workflow.
boundary_patch_notes: Do not train trading probability, buy/sell signals, or final-gate decisions.

decisions.reason: Shadow testing, paper/fill non-equivalence, and Phase 41 runtime boundary evidence now support staged champion/challenger promotion with Phase 37 references.
content_patch_notes: Formal reviewed draft must require offline_eval_report, shadow_eval_report, paper_replay_report, soft_gate_eval_report, canary_plan, owner_approval_ref, stop_condition, and rollback_condition.
Paper/replay must carry fill_cost_assumption_ref, replay_engine_version, market_data_replay_policy_ref, and non_equivalence_caveat=true.
boundary_patch_notes: AI Engineering manages promotion evidence and references only.
Fill model, fee, slippage, market impact, order-state machine, and execution latency body belong to Phase 37 / Trading Engineering.

decisions.reason: NIST least privilege, OWASP LLM security, and Phase 41 runtime contract now support read-only resolver, minimal permission, and portable config boundaries.
content_patch_notes: Formal reviewed draft must require read_only=true, no_write_back_to_cek_ta=true, resolver_version, allowed_paths, forbidden_paths, and portable_config_ref.
Runtime absolute machine path dependency must remain forbidden.
boundary_patch_notes: External projects must not write CEK-TA through MCP/adapter and must not bypass resolver path policy.

decisions.reason: SRE, FCA algorithmic-trading control, SEC Knight Capital risk case, and Phase 41 runtime contract now support latency budget, timeout, fallback, fail-to-review, and fail-closed controls.
content_patch_notes: Formal reviewed draft must require latency_budget_ms, timeout_ms, fallback_action, fail_closed_or_fail_to_review, and kill_switch_ref per runtime component.
Any component failure must never default allow; paper/live final_gate_timeout must fail_closed.
boundary_patch_notes: Fallback can route only to human review, safe degradation, rule baseline, no_source_abstain, no_llm_explanation, or fail_closed.
Fallback must not create automatic allow/block without final-gate policy.
